title: Context transition on a table with duplicated rows: each copy gets the sum of all its copies
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( Dup, "T", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Dup[Value] ) ) )

source.quote: if you use context transition in a table that contains duplicated rows, the filter context generated by CALCULATE includes all the duplicates
source.supports: the filter made by context transition filters column values, so it includes every duplicate of the row

source.quote: the filter context generated by CALCULATE places a filter on all the columns of the table to identify a single row, not on its row number
source.supports: the filter is on all the columns of the table, not on a row number

derivation: Dup has rows (A, 10) twice, (B, 5) once, (C, 1) three times. The transition filters Name and Value to the current row's values. For an A row the filter Name = A, Value = 10 matches both A rows: 10 + 10 = 20. B: 5. For a C row it matches three rows: 1 + 1 + 1 = 3. ADDCOLUMNS over a table reference keeps the duplicated rows, so 6 rows.
